sections.reason: The nav combines brand, route metadata, nav links, and an action link. A custom block preserves semantic header/nav markup and exposes each visible text item through RichText-backed attributes.
The hero contains a multi-line editorial heading, a definition-list sensor board, and positioned orbit map nodes. Core blocks would either lose the semantic map structure or require arbitrary HTML.

The section copy is ordinary editable heading/paragraph content. The asymmetric repeated stall set is a custom array-backed block because each item has a stable semantic article contract and visual variant.
The heading copy maps cleanly to core blocks. The horizontal rail needs repeated time/title/body entries with a highlighted item and semantic time elements.
The structure is simple text blocks inside section/article containers. Core group containers plus heading/paragraph blocks keep the content editable without a custom block.
The explanatory copy is core. The RSVP component must render a real form on save and expose field labels/button text as editable content.
The footer is a simple semantic p plus anchor layout. A custom block avoids inventing core/link and keeps the saved markup identical to the mockup.
